title: Acherontia atropos 2019 09 29 DTestaert Albussac
author: Dominique Testart
changes: Death's-head hawkmoth (Acherontia atropos) squeaking: the rapid chirping squeaks this big moth makes when disturbed, by pushing air through its mouthparts. Trimmed to 4.70–7.60 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 300 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 0.3 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The 300 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency rumble from handling; the squeaks themselves sit above 2 kHz.
